policy: Official picks use Hubáček gates: decorrelated model beats the de-vigged market by a backtested per-league gap, honest EV floor (calibrated pre-decorrelation probability), and a per-bet-type confidence bar (defaults 20 pp moneyline, 10 pp baseball/soccer, 5 pp spread cover). Live thresholds live in web/hubacek_picks.py; per-league overrides are stored here from walk-forward bet backtests. Enable bar: positive worst-season ROI at the execution price we would actually take (prefer multi-season).

mlb.note: MLB v2 (75 features) walk-forward backtest 2026-07-12 (scripts/backtest_mlb_bets.py): raw model-market gap >= 6 pp (6.7 pp after 1.12x decorrelation), EV >= 0%, prices -200..+200. Opening-line ROI +5.93% (1030 bets, 2024-2026, all 3 seasons positive, worst +4.01%, CLV +8.13%); closing-line floor -2.61%. Morning bets sit between open and close.

nba.note: NBA v2 (90 features) walk-forward backtest 2026-07-12 (scripts/backtest_nba_bets.py): market-aware margin cover gap >= 10 pp and point edge >= 3 at the opening spread. Opening-line ROI +20.77% (451 bets, 2024-2025 open-odds window, both seasons positive, worst +15.63%). Bets recorded in the morning sit between the open and close.

wnba.note: Official tracking disabled after 2026-07-12 re-backtest. Best open-line pure-margin policy (cover gap >= 10 pp) has ROI +4.33% / 259 bets but worst-season ROI -0.97% (2024) — fails the positive worst-season enable bar. Gate parameters kept for research; re-enable only after a multi-season positive worst-season open (or non-terrible close floor).

cbb.note: Official tracking stays disabled. CBBGradientBoost v2 (70 features). 2026-07-12 close-line Hubacek sweep still catastrophic (−57.62% best / 3994 bets on 2024–25 window). Open-line research best +3.41% / 1640 bets is single-season only — does not clear the enable bar. Expand odds: python scripts/fetch_cbb_odds.py --start-season 2022 --end-season 2026.

nfl.note: NFLGradientBoost v2 is live for predictions (65 features; live nflverse QB/coach/weather). Official picks stay disabled: 2026-07-12 close-only Hubacek sweep best worst-season ROI −16.22% (overall +2.45% / 563 bets, 8/16 seasons positive). nflverse has no opening lines. Gate parameters are research-best only.

cfb.note: CFBGradientBoost v2 is live for predictions (60 features). Official picks stay disabled: 2026-07-12 best close policy worst-season ROI −4.97% (overall −2.81%); best open worst −5.44%. Gate parameters kept for research only.

nhl.note: Official tracking disabled after 2026-07-12 re-backtest. Best open-line policy (raw gap >= 2.5 pp → 2.8 pp after 1.12x decorrelation, EV >= 0%, ML −350..+300) has overall ROI +5.93% / 2432 bets and CLV +2.38%, but worst-season open ROI −1.26% (2024) — fails the positive worst-season enable bar. Close 12-season ROI +4.7% also has negative worst (−3.86%). Prior 7 pp gate is worse on this OOS (open worst −6.77%). Re-enable only after positive worst-season at execution price.

epl.note: Soccer v2 pooled top-5 walk-forward backtest 2026-07-12 (scripts/backtest_soccer_bets.py): market-aware calibrated home prob beats the devigged opening line by >= 4 pp raw (4.6 pp after 1.15x decorrelation), EV >= 5% — home outcomes only. Best-price execution ROI +8.6% across 2015-2025 (1771 bets, 9/11 seasons positive, worst −4.35%, CLV +4.16%).
